verdict.rationale: smolagents documents pushing an agent to the Hub 'as a Space repository' and loading it back with from_hub, but this is described as sharing, not as deploying to a managed runtime with a callable API endpoint. Any hosting would come from the Hugging Face Spaces host platform, not from smolagents itself. The sandbox integrations (Modal, E2B, Docker, Blaxel) isolate code execution and are not agent-serving runtimes. The OpenAPI probe describes the Hugging Face Hub's own API, not a per-agent endpoint.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can deploy an agent to a managed runtime and call it as an API endpoint
